versions.changelog:
Initial release of the auto-updater skill.

- Automatically checks for and applies updates to Clawdbot and all installed skills once daily.
- Configures a cron job to run updates at a customizable time (default 4:00 AM).
- Sends a detailed summary message after each update run, including what changed.
- Provides manual commands and troubleshooting guidance for easy maintenance.
- Supports both npm/package manager and source (git) installations.
